Short Term Assistance for Fraternal and Social Organizations
September 25, 2026 05:31 PM to All Senate Members
Circulated By
Senator Wayne Fontana
D Senate District 42
Memo
Fraternal and social establishments play an indispensable role in communities across Pennsylvania. They aid our veterans, civic leaders, and service organizations and add character and the opportunity for camaraderie to our neighborhoods.
 
In June, the Pennsylvania Supreme Court correctly ruled that so-called “skill games” are gambling devices—covered under the Gaming Act—and therefore are illegal because they are not operating in facilities licensed by the PA Gaming Control Board. The Court provided the General Assembly with 120 days to take action before the law must be enforced.
 
With no agreement imminent, I am introducing legislation to assist our fraternal and social organizations in the short-term and bridge the gap between the October 13 shut-off date and a long-term solution.
 
My proposal will allow Pennsylvania’s fraternal and social organizations with PA Liquor Control Board Club Licenses to keep up to five machines on premises until a sunset date of December 31, 2027.
 
I hope you will consider joining me in co-sponsoring this piece of legislation.
